summary: Iteration 15 tested the production login/auth regression, protected navigation, Bearer propagation, refresh persistence, logout, landing responsiveness, and Reset Data APIs/UI. Backend pytest: 13 passed, 1 failed (92.9%). Arjun picker/password login works, stores session_token in localStorage, reaches /app/dashboard, sends Bearer headers on protected Axios calls, survives refresh, and supports Tasks/Settings navigation. Normal UI logout clears localStorage. Desktop/mobile landing and Reset Data UI passed. One backend inconsistency remains: /api/auth/logout still prioritizes the cookie over the Authorization header when both differ.

critical.issue: Logout selects session_token cookie before the explicit Authorization Bearer token. With a stale/conflicting cookie, it deletes the cookie session while leaving the Bearer/localStorage session valid, contradicting the new header-priority auth behavior and preventing reliable server-side logout of the active token.

action_items: Update POST /api/auth/logout to prefer a valid Authorization Bearer token over session_token cookie, matching get_current_user, then re-run the iteration 15 regression test.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:339 uses `session_token if session_token else Authorization`, while get_current_user correctly uses Authorization first. Centralize token extraction to prevent auth/logout precedence from diverging again.
server.py (3338 lines) and Settings.js (970 lines) exceed the 700-line maintainability threshold; split backend routers/services and Settings tabs into focused modules.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Login generated temporary sessions; tests logged out their temporary sessions. The safe Reset Data success test used an unknown collection name and deleted zero records.
test_credentials: Partner and staff credentials were loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iteration15_auth_reset.py after fixing logout precedence. All other requested checks passed: login/localStorage, global Bearer headers, refresh persistence, dashboard/tasks/settings navigation, normal UI logout, desktop/mobile landing, mobile hamburger, data-stats RBAC/counts, Managing Partner reset RBAC, and exact RESET confirmation.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: create partner and staff sessions, POST /api/auth/logout with partner Authorization header plus staff session cookie, then GET /api/auth/me with both tokens separately. The partner token remains valid and staff token is invalidated. Root cause is logout line 339 choosing the cookie first instead of sharing the Authorization-first extraction used by get_current_user.
